findings.note: Landscape availH = geo.height - 116 treats chrome as fixed, ignoring the FlowLayout toolbar wrapping to 2 rows AND the DailyHUD/demoBar that adds an extra bar above the board during a daily challenge or the win-demo. With this commit's fan 0.24->0.34 and constant 138->116, a moderately long column can clip at the bottom earlier than the documented known-minor — worst case the bottom (draggable) card runs off-screen. Fix: subtract the HUD/demo bar height from availH when one is showing (game.challengeDay != nil || game.demoing || game.demoDoneMessage != nil), and give a bit more base chrome margin, so an ~11-card column still fits even with the HUD bar.

Header comment says cards fit an '11-across width (2 foundation + 8 tableau + 1 free-cell columns)' but the layout + formula are 15-across (4 foundation + 8 tableau + 3 free-cell). Contradicts the correct comment at the width formula. Fix the comment to 15-across.
